lead.what: Taiwan released a map identifying Chinese naval and other official vessels, including the Liaoning’s group east of the Philippines.

rest.what: South Korea says it has made no decision on a possible Hormuz deployment; earlier options included P-8A maritime-patrol aircraft.

lead.what: The Bank of Canada raised its overnight-rate target by 25 basis points to 2.5%.

rest.what: Jio Platforms debuted after raising $3.2 billion in an initial public offering.

lead.what: Hong Kong Housing Secretary Winnie Ho resigned to take political responsibility for last year’s Wang Fuk Court fire.

rest.what: The draft Canada–EU statement calls for an ever closer association rather than an associate-member grant.
